metadata.author: Marco Ivaldi <raptor@0xdeadbeef.info>

extra.message: Locate all calls to interesting and potentially insecure API functions (candidate points). The auditor can backtrace from these candidate points to find pathways allowing access from untrusted input.
The rand() PRNG should not be used in applications intended to be  portable when good randomness is needed. Instead, the use of random()  is recommended.
